segments.he: אִם אָמְרָה ״טְמֵאָה אֲנִי״ וְכוּ׳. שָׁמְעַתְּ מִינַּהּ כּוֹתְבִין שׁוֹבָר.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «If» after the judge’s warning «she says: I am defiled,» she writes a receipt for her marriage contract. The Gemara comments: «You» can «learn from this» mishna «that one writes a receipt» to serve as proof that a debt has been paid rather than tearing the promissory note. This matter is the subject of a dispute between the tanna’im in tractate Bava Batra (170b).
